basic_info.description: 3 Bedrooms on the Main Level. This is a fantastic opportunity for home ownership in the Excelsior District. Beautifully updated home - in move in ready condition.  Gorgeous new floors throughout.  Living room with fireplace, formal dining room, Updated eat-in kitchen with new appliances and 3 bedrooms. The primary bedroom has direct access to the bathroom through a walk-in closet. The main level has maintained a lot of the original charm with crown molding throughout the living areas and lots of natural light.  Downstairs offers a full basement with high ceilings and 1/2 bath. There is a spacious rear yard perfect for summer BBQ's, children or a family pet.   This is an absolutely fantastic property. Must See...
